sn56.96-101:1.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye chedana-vadha-bandhana-viparāmosa-ālopa-sahasākārā paṭiviratā. atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye chedana-vadha-bandhana-viparāmosa-ālopa-sahasākārā appaṭiviratā.
sn56.96-101:1.5: dukkhassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhanirodhassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa.
sn56.96-101:2.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo. “ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo”ti yogo karaṇīyo. “ayaṃ dukkhanirodho”ti yogo karaṇīyo. “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
